notes: Optimizer losses are reported medians where multiple runs exist; HyperBall largely has one run per point.
Min/max are observed ranges, not confidence intervals.
Endpoint penalties are in 1e-3 nats, evaluated on 10.5M held-out tokens.

cifar.metric: per-example validation loss averaged over final ten evaluations

scaling_rules.scope: All original single-seed complete scaling-rule grids, with the paper full-retuning reference points kept separately. Rule rankings and common-rule selection retain the original all-target grid-regret definition. No auxiliary weight-decay extensions or confidence intervals.
scaling_rules.display_gap: Original-grid validation loss minus the lowest recorded loss at the same batch across the original grid and available paper full-retuning medians. Differences are naturally nonnegative without clipping. Both loss views use linear y axes; displayed means weight every target batch equally. CIFAR 64/128 use grid minima because no independent retuning baseline was measured.

signsgd_cnr.metric: Monte Carlo expected terminal loss; independently tuned learning rate per batch
